label: Opening Hook
text: Under one of the largest domes of the pre-modern world, in Vijayapura, India, a whisper can carry right across the gallery.
title: File:Gol Gumbaz, the mausoleum of Mohammed Adil Shah, in Vijaypura 01.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Mausoleum of Sultan Mohammed Adil Shah, completed in 1656 Its dome is about 44 m across externally, among the largest pre-modern domes A whispering gallery runs around the base of the dome Sounds are said to echo many times, often quoted as seven or more Located in Vijayapura (formerly Bijapur), Karnataka
title: File:Gol Gumbaz, the mausoleum of Mohammed Adil Shah, in Vijaypura 12.jpg
